title: 12-name watchlist · 4 November 2026, 04:00 SGT
summary: Nine watchlist names rose and three fell versus the prior regular close in individually timestamped active-session observations. AMD led at +4.05%; Apple lagged at −2.48%. All 12 completed closes and 72 return baselines were rechecked and are unchanged. New NVIDIA and Amazon posts, an Apple feed update and Reuters market-reaction updates are included. Meta’s preliminary financing filing is earlier coverage newly checked, not a new review-window event.
coverage_note: Review window: 4 November 2026, 00:00–04:00 SGT (3 November 16:00–20:00 UTC), with overlap against earlier editions. All 12 completed closes and 72 adjusted-close baselines were independently rechecked, and 12 active-session snapshots were checked before the fixed cutoff. Earlier research is retained with its original dates and qualifications. Source access and news coverage remain partial; no newly verified item for a company is not proof that no news occurred.
price_basis: The US regular session was open at the fixed 4 November 04:00 SGT cutoff (3 November 15:00 EST). Main price fields use the last completed close: 2 November 2026, 16:00 EST (3 November 05:00 SGT), versus 30 October. Separate active-session observations are saved in the per-stock research, timestamped 3 November 14:41–14:57 EST (4 November 03:41–03:57 SGT). Source timestamps have minute precision; seconds were not supplied. All prices are USD. TSM is the US-listed USD ADR. These are saved observations, not a live feed or synchronized cutoff prices.
return_basis: Cumulative return = 100*(2 November 2026 adjusted close / baseline adjusted close - 1). The 1–6 calendar-month baseline dates are 2 October, 2 September, 31 July, 2 July, 2 June and 1 May 2026. The 2 August and 2 May anniversaries fall on Sunday and Saturday, so the preceding trading sessions are used. All 72 dated inputs were independently rechecked on the linked vendor series. Adjusted closes account for splits and dividends/distributions; ordinary previous closes remain separate. These are cumulative returns before fees and taxes, not individual monthly returns. They remain unchanged from the 00:00 SGT edition.
caveats: Active-session snapshots are not synchronized; they span 03:41–03:57 SGT, 3–19 minutes before the cutoff. None is claimed to be an exact 04:00 SGT quote.
The schema has no active-quote field. Completed-close prices and return inputs remain in the main fields; premarket is null and the active observations are explicitly labelled in research.

Older adjusted-close rows were independently retrieved through current search-indexed Yahoo Finance pages, including French and Hong Kong variants, and Quiver where cited. Direct Yahoo page access was limited. Stale or inconsistently adjusted alternatives were excluded.

TSM uses Yahoo-adjusted baseline values consistently. Its 2 September adjusted close is 414.39 versus 414.62 in the Stock Analysis series; the Yahoo value and all TSM return inputs are unchanged from the prior edition.

The BRK.B page displaying 15:00 EST did not supply seconds and was excluded at the cutoff boundary. A verified 14:43 EST price from the Stock Analysis forecast page is used; no analyst rating is adopted as a user call.

Earlier Reuters premarket observations and the attributed, unconfirmed NVIDIA/Financial Times account are retained with their original dates and qualifications. Carrying them forward does not independently confirm the underlying report.
Prior active-session and premarket observations remain in immutable earlier editions. Comparisons below use their individual timestamps and are not synchronized portfolio returns.

Watch only: no holding, executed trade, user buy call or recommendation is implied. Only public company and market information is included; no private diary, brokerage record, account information or restricted screenshot is imported.
Direct Reuters US markets and technology pages could not be opened. Accessible Reuters syndication and targeted searches were used.
No blanket no-news finding is made for any ticker.
All source checks were performed after the cutoff, using source publication/update/acceptance timestamps to exclude later information.

All 12 issuers’ SEC recent-submissions JSON lists were retrieved directly; no listed acceptance timestamp fell in 15:45–20:00 UTC. This is not a complete third-party ownership-filing census. Reuters and IR company-news coverage remains partial. New commentary/product/program posts do not establish a quantified earnings effect.
